notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.8
notes.content: Fixed an issue that was preventing one of the new animations from playing.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.7
notes.content: Fixed issues that were preventing players who had experienced achievement-related bugs prior to update 1.0.6 from earning the relevant achievements.

notes.title: Bugfix version 1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed two issues introduced in patch 1.0.4:
- Fixed issue where certain parts of the screen could not clicked to advance the dialogue in the phone call sequence
- Fixed soft-lock that could occur when repeatedly restarting a playthrough

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]This update fixes several small bugs:
[/b]- Fixed bug where phone ring would be audible even when volume slider was all the way down
- Fixed bugs in several minigames where clicking the pause button would be registered as a game input
- Fixed bug in Seat Wiper that caused the 'sogginess' meter of a new toilet paper wad to appear at max when it was first torn off
- Fixed bug in Seat Wiper where disposing of a toilet paper wad could, in certain scenarios, cause the wad to 'float' over the toilet seat as if it was in the water
- Fixed visual layering issue with bodily fluids in Seat Wiper

[b]One small feature has been added as well:
[/b]- Minigames will not start repeating for a new player unless they have already completed each one at least once

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed bug that was causing the "Destined For The Throne" achievement not to be unlocked even after unlocking all minigames.

If you have been affected by this bug, the achievement should unlock next time you play the game.

Thank you to everyone who reported these issues! We have more fixes coming in the near future.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where the game could freeze upon getting a game over.
